function_signature: def compute_cpa(traces: np.ndarray, plaintexts: np.ndarray, key_byte_idx: int) -> np.ndarray
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (11 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: No for-loop over the N traces (numpy vectorization required)
zero-variance columns must be guarded against division by zero (returning 0 rather than NaN)
